subject: Support elevation and operational cutover for upcoming renewal
messages:
From: Emily Park <epark@argentcloud.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: ops-team@argentcloud.com, procurement@argentcloud.com
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal options — support elevation ahead of Q3 renewal

Hi Ben,

Our contract with Redwood comes up for renewal July 15. Over the last 9 months our usage has increased ~3.6x, and we're preparing to move a set of latency-sensitive features to production. Before renewal the leadership team wants to evaluate upgrading our support tier to a Premier SLA and add a latency p95 SLO (we're targeting 120ms p95 for inference in our EU region) and a capacity commitment to cover 4x current peak throughput.

Specifically we'd like:
- Premier support (24x7 phone + priority escalation)
- A documented latency SLO with rollback/fallback plan
- Commitment for burst capacity (4x baseline) and documented scaling windows
- An amendment we can route through procurement/DocuSign by end of June

Can you share an outline of what the Premier SLA looks like (support response times, on-call handoff, runbook), high-level pricing for the capacity uplift, and an implementation timetable? I've attached our latest usage export.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Park
Head of Platform
ArgentCloud
Attachment: current-usage-report.csv (csv)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <epark@argentcloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal options — support elevation ahead of Q3 renewal

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear note and the usage export. Appreciate the heads-up on the latency target and capacity goals.

Short answer: yes, we can put a Premier SLA and a capacity commitment in place for your renewal. High-level next steps:
- I'll loop in Marissa (CS) to own the onboarding/runbook and Grace (SE) for the cutover plan.
- We'll produce a 2-page SLA addendum and a migration timetable you can review.
- Rishi will include commercial options (monthly vs annual commit) and a quote.

Proposed immediate timeline:
- Week of 4/26: internal alignment and draft SLA + quote (attached: proposed-sla-options.pdf)
- Week of 5/3: technical deep-dive and canary window planning with your ops team
- Target cutover/canary: first week of May (can be adjusted)
- Final amendment and DocuSign: by 6/30 to meet your July 15 renewal date

I've attached a shortlist of Premier SLA features and an example runbook. Can we set a 30-min sync on Tue 4/20 to walk through?

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0192
Attachment: proposed-sla-options.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T08:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal options — support elevation ahead of Q3 renewal

Team — following Ben's note, draft of the internal cutover/runbook and timeline. This message is internal only.

Summary (high level):
- Objective: Elevate ArgentCloud to Premier SLA, add a latency SLO (p95 120ms target), and commit to 4x burst capacity.
- Success criteria: Service sustainment under 4x traffic with p95 <= 120ms in US region for 2 consecutive 24h windows during canary.

Proposed internal timetable:
1) 4/26–4/30: Draft amendment + engineering runbook (deliverable: runbook-sla-cutover-v1.docx).
2) 5/03–5/07: Canary prep — create isolated canary pool, KV cache warm, telemetry hooks, alert rules.
3) 5/10: Canary day 0 — soft load test (80% traffic) + validation (latency and error budget check).
4) 5/12: Full canary (100% of traffic for feature set A) monitored for 48h.
5) 5/17: Rollout to remaining clusters conditional on no regression.

Operational hooks and ownership:
- On-call: Redwood operations primary (Grace) for canary, handover to ArgentCloud SREs via shared runbook and 2-hour overlap for the first 72h.
- Escalation matrix: P0 -> Redwood SRE -> Redwood Head of Operations -> ArgentCloud CTO loop-in.

Open items for commercial: what indemnities or credits the customer expects for SLO breaches, and whether they need multi-region p95 guarantees (they asked EU earlier).

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Emily Park <epark@argentcloud.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@argentcloud.com, ops-team@argentcloud.com
Date: 2027-04-22T10:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal options — support elevation ahead of Q3 renewal

Ben / Marissa — thanks, that timeline looks reasonable. Two clarifications from our side:

1) We need explicit 24x7 on-call with a guaranteed <30-minute phone response for P0 incidents as part of the addendum.
2) We'd like the SLO to include EU region at the same p95 target; if you need additional capacity in EU that's OK — include regional uplift pricing.

Procurement would prefer a single amendment we can sign (DocuSign). Please include the contact procurement@argentcloud.com on the routing.

If you can get a draft amendment and the commercial quote in the next week we'll review internally and loop in finance.

Thanks — Emily
Emily Park
Head of Platform, ArgentCloud

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-23T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal options — support elevation ahead of Q3 renewal

Internal commercial note: preliminary pricing attached. Two commercial paths:

A) Annual commitment (recommended): 12-month committed capacity + Premier SLA addendum. Lower effective unit price, includes 24x7 on-call and 99.95% availability credit terms.
B) Term-limited uplift: 6-month capacity uplift + Premier SLA. Slightly higher per-unit price, flexible exit.

For ArgentCloud's volumes I'm recommending path A with a 12-month commit at 1.8x their current avg usage (with burst to 4x guaranteed). That gets them a 22% discount vs month-to-month.

Open commercial questions for Ben to confirm with customer:
- Are they comfortable with a 12-month commitment?
- Do they want SLO financial credits (we typically offer tiered service credits tied to p95 breaches).

Attachment: quote-argentcloud-2027Q3.xlsx (xlsx)

Rishi
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
